Title: Committed Bedrock access credential
Impact: Cloud credential exposure and possible unauthorized AWS use
Recommendation: Rotate revoke and purge history then use external credential configuration

Title: Inbound Jira request lacks application-level authenticity checks
Impact: Authorized Salesforce callers can initiate privileged generation and deployment
Recommendation: Use integration-only OAuth plus signed replay-protected request validation

Title: Synchronous multi-call LLM work in REST transaction
Impact: Request can exceed synchronous callout and transaction limits
Recommendation: Durably queue orchestration and return HTTP 202

Title: Verbose ticket org-state and model-output logging
Impact: Sensitive business and generated-code data may be exposed through logs
Recommendation: Redact logs and use correlation IDs with retention controls

Title: No LWC Jest tests
Recommendation: Create LWC Jest tests and enforce coverage in CI

Title: ESLint script matches no files
Recommendation: Use a quoted force-app-relative cross-platform glob

Title: Jira callback failures are silently ignored
Impact: Deployment result can remain stale in Jira
Recommendation: Use durable retry and alert terminal callback failures

Title: Model-directed post-deploy executeAnonymous action
Impact: Generated code can run privileged post-deploy logic
Recommendation: Remove feature or restrict to approved action registry

Title: Jira and legacy Groq secrets are ordinary custom-setting text fields
Impact: Token access and per-user configuration are hard to govern
Recommendation: Use named and external credentials plus least-privilege permission sets

Title: Manifest references absent permission set
Impact: Selective deployment can fail or omit access configuration
Recommendation: Correct manifest and package permission metadata

Title: Existing code scan reads every Apex class body
Impact: Large orgs can hit limits and disclose unnecessary code
Recommendation: Query targeted classes and cap or summarize content

Title: Groq facade and configuration actually route to Bedrock
Recommendation: Implement provider strategy or remove obsolete Groq assets

Title: AI code review invocation is commented out
Impact: Unused code and misleading architectural surface
Recommendation: Delete or restore with tests and documented policy

Title: Oversized core classes concentrate parser rules
Impact: Change risk and weak unit isolation
Recommendation: Split by responsibility and fixture-test each rule family
